_note: Adhoc scene (Script Standard §14) wiring the developer module adhoc/quiz.js. `call`ed from s01_intro as a subroutine: both real exits `return: true`, so when the quiz resolves the engine resumes s01_intro at the next command, where an `if` branches on `passed`. The module's result writes `quiz_score`+`passed` back into the flow. `fallback` keeps the game completable on a runtime that can't run the module (it takes the fail exit). The questions/passMark/exit ids are all data in `params`, so the same generic module is reusable.
